title: The Glory of the Creature
reading:
Murray begins with a foundational truth: humility is the glory of the creature. We were created to live in complete dependence upon God. Just as the moon reflects the sun's light, so we reflect God's glory only when we remain surrendered to Him.

Pride begins when we forget we are created beings. Humility restores the proper order — God as everything, and we as joyful receivers.

True humility is not self-hatred. It is clear-sighted joy in belonging wholly to God.
reflection: Where do I subtly resist dependence on God? Do I experience dependence as weakness or freedom? What areas of my life function as though I am self-made?
abide: Rest here a moment. You are a creature held by your Creator. That is not a burden — it is your deepest freedom.
